2. Definitions.---(2) In
this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context-
(a)
"Academic Council" means the Academic Council of the University;
(b)
"Authority" means any of the authorities of the University specified
in section 17;
(c)
"Board" means the Board of Governors of the University;
(d)
"Chairman" means the Chairman of the Board;
(e)
"Constitute unit" means an institute or college maintained or
administered by the University;
(f)
"Chancellor" means the Chancellor of the University;
(g)
"Dean" means the Chairman of a Faculty of the University;
(h)

1980.
(i)
"Director" means the administrative head of a constituent college or
campus of the University;
(j)
"Faculty" means a Faculty of the University;
(k)
"Government" means Government of Sindh;
(l)
"Head" means Head of a Teaching Department of the University;
(m)
"Principal" means the Principal of a constituent unit;
(n)
"Pro-Vice-Chancellor" means the Pro-Vice-Chancellor of the
University;
(o)
"Registrar" means the Registrar of the University;
(p)
"Statutes", "regulations" and "rules" means
prescribed statutes, regulations and rules
made under this Ordinance;
(q)
"Teacher" means Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor
and Lecturer engaged whole time by the University for teaching and any other
person as may be declared to be the teacher;
(r)
"Teaching Department" means teaching department established and maintained by the University;
(s)
"UGC" means University Grants Commission;
(t)
"University" means the Defence Housing Authority Suffa University
Karachi; and
(u)
"Vice-Chancellor" means the Vice Chancellor of the University.

Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(15)/2002,
dated 27-5-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
3. Establishment and
Incorporation of the University. ---(1) There shall be established a University
to be called the Defence Housing Authority Suffa University, Karachi,
consisting of-
(a)
the Chancellor, the Vice-Chancellor, the Pro-Vice-Chancellor, the Deans, the Director, the Principal and the members
of the Board;
(b)
the members of such councils, boards, committees and other bodies as the Board may establish;
(c)
the teachers of the University and its constituent units; and
(d)
such other officers and members of the staff as may from time to time be specified by the Board.
(2) The University shall be a
body corporate by the name of the Defence Housing Authority Suffa University,
Karachi, having perpetual succession and a common seal, with powers, among
others, to acquire, hold and dispose of any property moveable or immovable and shall
by said name sue and be sued.

provide for the establishment of a University known as the Defence Housing

[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(15)/2002,
dated 27-5-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
4. Powers and Functions of the
University.--Subject to the instructions prescribed by Government from time
to time, the University shall have the powers-
(1) to provide for instruction
and training in such branches of learning as it may deem fit, and to make
provisions for research, demonstration, and for the advancement and
dissemination of knowledge in such manner as it may determine;
(2) to select, admit and examine
students;
(3) to hold examinations and
confer or award degrees, diplomas, certificate and others academic distinctions
on the persons who have passed its examinations under or have participated in
its executive development programmes under prescribed conditions;
(4) to establish and promote
faculties;
(5) to confer honorary degrees on
persons as approved by the Patron;
(6) to prescribe courses of
studies in such branches of learning as it may determine;
(7) to pursue and publish
research;
(8) to provide other facilities
for education, training and research;
(9) the University may affiliate
and disaffiliate only those educational institutions which are financed and run
by the Authority;
(10) to associate and collaborate
with other institutions and Universities;
(11) to enter into, carry out or
cancel agreements contracts and arrangements with other universities,
organizations, institutions, bodies and individuals for the purpose of carrying
out its functions and activities;
(12) to create posts for
teaching, research, administration and other related functions and to appoint
persons thereto;
(13) to receive and manage properties, grants, bequests,
trusts, gifts, donations, endowments and other contributions made to it and to
invest any funds representing such properties, grants, bequests, trusts, gifts,
donations, endowments or contributions and to convert one kind of property into
another, in such manner as it may deem fit; and
(14) to do all such other acts
and things as may be required to further its objectives, as per provisions of
the charter/policy of the Government.

5. Teaching and Examinations
in the University.--(1) The academic programmes of the University shall be
conducted in the prescribed manner.
(2) The University shall
associate external examiners for the conduct of examinations.
(3) No degree shall be granted
unless a student has passed an examination in Islamic Studies and Pakistan
Studies at the Bachelor's degree level or, in the case of non-Muslim student,
in Ethics and Pakistan Studies as his or her option.
(4) In prescribing syllabi,
courses of studies and instructions for the conduct of studies, the University
shall abide by the direction given by Governor or University Grants Commission.

9. Visitation. ---(1) The
Patron may cause an inspection or inquiry to be made on his own motion in
respect of any matter connected with the affairs -of the University and shall,
from time to time direct any person or persons to inquire into or carry out
inspection of-
(a)
the University, its buildings, laboratories, libraries, and other facilities;
(b)
any institution, department or hostel maintained by the University and the adequacy of financial and human
resources of the University;
(c)
the teaching, research, curriculum, examinations and other matters of the University; and
(d)
such other matters as may be specified by him.
(2) The Patron shall communicate
to the Board his views with regard to the result' of visitation and shall,
after ascertaining the views thereon of the Board, advise the Board on the
action to be taken by it.
(3) The Board shall, within such
time .as may be specified by the Patron, communicate him such action, if any,
as has been taken or may be proposed to be taken upon the result of visitation.
(4) Where the Board does not,
within the time specified, take action to the satisfaction of the Patron, the
Patron may issue such directions as he deems fit and the Board shall comply
with all such directions.
(5) The Patron shall have full
powers to take any action as he may deem fit against the University including
withdrawal of charter and its closure if it is found in any unlawful
activities.

Chancellor

DEFENCE HOUSING AUTHORITY SUFFA
DEFENCE HOUSING
AUTHORITY SUFFA
UNIVERSITY

An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of a University known as the Defence Housing

[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 2002]
No. S. Legis. I(15)/2002,
dated 27-5-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
10. Chancellor. ---(1) The
President of the Executive Board of the Defence Housing Authority shall be
Chancellor.
(2) The Chancellor shall, when
present preside at the meetings of the Board.
(3) The Chancellor shall appoint
Vice-Chancellor and Pro-Vice- Chancellor.
(4) If the Chancellor is
satisfied that the proceedings of any Authority or orders of any officer are
not in accordance with the provisions of this Ordinance, the statutes, the
regulations or the rules, he may after calling upon such Authority or officer
to show cause why such proceedings should not be annulled by order in writing
annul such proceedings or orders.
(5) The Chancellor may remove any
person from the membership of any Authority if such person-
(i)
has become of unsound mind; or
(ii)
has been incapacitated to function as a member of such Authority; or
(iii)
has been convicted by a Court of law, for an offence involving moral turpitude; or
(iv)
has been found indulging in-any activity against the interest of the
University.
(6) The Chancellor shall have the
power to assent statutes submitted by the Board or withhold assent or refer
them back to the Board for reconsideration.

11. The Vice-Chancellor. ---(1)
The Vice-Chancellor, who shall be an eminent educationist of distinction,
'shall be appointed by the Chancellor on the recommendations of the Board for a
period of three years on such terms and conditions as the Chancellor may
determine in consultation with the Board and shall hold office during the
pleasure of the Chancellor.
(2) The Vice-Chancellor shall be
the Chief Executive and academic officer of the University and shall be
responsible for observing the provisions of this Ordinance and for the
execution of the programme of the University in accordance with the guidelines
and policies formulated by the Board.
(3) The Vice-Chancellor shall
have powers to-
(i)
submit plans of work and budget estimates of the University for the consideration of the Board;
(ii)
direct the activities connected with the execution of programmes for instruction, training and research;
(iii)
authorize expenditure provided for in the approved budget and to re-appropriate funds within the same major
head of expenditure and report it to the
Board in the next meeting;
(iv)
sanction and re-appropriate an amount not exceeding one lac rupees for an unseen item not provided for in the
budget, and report it to the Board in the next meeting;
(v)
appoint, with the approval of the Board, teachers, officers and members of the staff of the University and such other
persons as may be necessary in accordance with
policies and procedures approved by the Board so as to ensure, the highest intellectual and, moral qualities in the
persons appointed;
(vi)
submit to the Board, in accordance with the rules of procedure, a report on the
activities of the University and
the execution of the plans of the work;
(vii)
create and fill temporary posts for a period not exceeding six months; and
(viii)
perform any work assigned by the Board.

12. Pro-Vice-Chancellor.---(1)
The Chancellor may, in consultation with the Vice-Chancellor, appoint a
Pro-Vice-Chancellor for the main campus or the additional campus, if any, or
for both the campuses jointly, on such terms and conditions and ,for such
period not exceeding four years at a time as the Chancellor may determine.
(2) The Pro-Vice-Chancellor
shall, notwithstanding anything contained in this Ordinance, exercise such
powers and perform such functions of the Vice-Chancellor or such other powers
and functions, in respect of the campus for which he is appointed, as the
Chancellor may delegate to him.
(3) The Pro-Vice-Chancellor shall
be ex-officio member of the Academic Council and shall be deemed to be included
in the University under section 3 and be an officer of the University under
section 6.

13. The Dean. ---(1) There
shall be a Dean of each Faculty who shall be its Chairman and the convener.
(2) The Dean shall be appointed
by the Board from amongst three most senior professors of the Faculty on the
recommendations of the Vice -Chancellor and shall hold office for a period of
two years and shall be eligible for re-appointment.
(3) The Dean shall be responsible
for the academic affairs of the faculty and present candidates for admission to
degree, except honorary degrees, in the courses falling within the purview of
the Faculty.
(4) The Dean shall exercise such
powers and perform such duties as may be prescribed by the Board on the
recommendations of the Vice -Chancellor.

14. Teaching Department. ---(1)
There shall be a Teaching Department for each subject or a group of subjects,
as may be prescribed by Regulations and each Department shall be headed by a
Chairman.
(2) The head of the Teaching
Department shall be appointed by the Board on the recommendations of the
Vice-Chancellor from amongst three most senior Professors or three most senior
Associate Professors other than the Professors already working as a Dean for a
period of two years and shall be eligible for re-appointment; provided that
where there is no Professor or Associate Professor, the Department shall be
looked after by the Dean of the Faculty with the assistance of the most senior
teacher of the Department.
(3) The Head of the Department
shall plan, organize and supervise the work of the Department and shall be
responsible to the Dean for the work of his Department.
(4) The Head of the Department
shall under the general supervision of the Vice-Chancellor and Dean, exercise
all administrative, financial anti academic powers and such other duties or
powers as may be delegated to him.
(5) The Head of the Department
shall prepare a comprehensive annual report on the performance of the
Department at graduate and postgraduate levels, and faculty research and
development and submit it to the Dean of the Faculty for evaluation.

19. Board of Governors. ---(1)
The general supervision and Control of the affairs of the University shall vest
in the Board consisting of the following:
(a) The Chancellor; who shall be
the Chairman of the Board;
(b) a Judge of the High Court;
nominated by the Chief Justice;
(c) the Secretary Education,
Government of Sindh or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional
Secretary;
(d) the Chairman, University
Grants Commission or his nominee;
(e) the Vice-Chancellor;
(f) the Pro-Vice-Chancellor;
(g) the Administrator, Defence
Housing Authority, Karachi;
(h) one Vice-.Chancellor of a
University nominated by the Chancellor;
(i) three nominees of the Defence
Housing Authority;
(j) two eminent educationists as
approved by the Chairman for two years;
(k) Chairman Chamber of Commerce
and Industry or his nominee; and
(l) The Registrar of the University
will act as Secretary of the Board but he will not have right of vote.
(2) the Members of the Board
other then ex-officio members unless removed or resigned from the membership
earlier shall hold office for two years.
(3) The Chairman may nominate any
member of the Board to act as Chairman in his absence.
(4) No act or proceedings of the
Board shall be invalid by reasons only of the existence of a vacancy in or any
defect in the constitution of the Board.
(5) The Chancellor may coopt a
person for consultation on special Issues.

20. Powers and Functions of
the Board of Governors. ---(1) The Board shall exercise the powers and
perform the functions as follows:--
(i) to hold, control and
administer the property, funds and resources of the University and raise funds
for the purpose of the University upon such security as may be required under
regulations;
(ii) to undertake responsibility
for the financial viability of the University including responsibility for
ensuring effectiveness of its operations, their continuity and preservation of
the autonomy of the University;
(iii) to consider and pass the
resolution of the annual report, plan of work, statements of accounts and the
annual budget estimates;
(iv) to formulate or approve
policies and plans governing the activities and operations of the University so
as to facilitate research, teaching and other academic work; .
(v) to make statutes;
(vi) to prepare or have prepared

administrative post a it may deem necessary and to approve appointments to such
posts as it may specify;

sub-committees as it may deem necessary;

it may consider necessary or desirable for the efficient and effective
management arid functioning of the University;

officers on the recommendations of the Selection Board; and

authority or officer, or a committee.

of the University.

sources.

financial liability of the University or which may involve an activity riot
included in its programmes for the time being shall not be accepted without the
prior approval of the Board.
